g.title: CTRL_FRONT_IN
g.text: Front LED input — from Killerbody 48102 ports 1/2 (FL) and 3/4 (FR)
Individual wire leads from KB48102 LED jack ports — not a formal JST header

The Killerbody 48102 outputs individual wire leads per LED port (not a header). Each port lead is soldered or crimped to the chassis harness input here. Ports 1+2 feed FL; ports 3+4 feed FR (Y-split from same FORWARD channel). KB48102 instruction sheet: killerbodyrc.com/Prod_image/instructions/48102.PDF

VERIFY: KB48102 may internally current-limit its port outputs for its included 5mm LEDs. If so, the series resistors in body-harness.wv are additional and will overdim the body LEDs. Measure open-circuit port voltage and short-circuit current before selecting resistor values for the magnetic contact delivery path.

g.title: W_FL_RUN
g.text: CTRL_FRONT_IN to FL satellite magnet. 26 AWG. Route inside left chassis rail.

g.title: W_FR_RUN

g.title: CTRL_REAR_IN
g.text: Rear LED input — from Killerbody 48102 ports 5 (RL) and 6 (RR)
Individual wire leads from KB48102 LED jack ports
Ports 5+6 on the KB48102 are the BACKWARD channel: dim when idle, bright on brake signal. Y-split: port 5 → RL, port 6 → RR.
